records.title: Weekly pressure inspection
records.text: Tubing pressure 182 bar. Minor seal seep at valve V-2. Follow-up inspection recommended within 48 hours.

records.title: Control-room shift log
records.text: Tubing pressure 147 bar recorded at the same 09:00 shift. Operator reports intermittent V-2 alarm.

records.title: Valve V-2 work order
records.text: Work order opened to inspect V-2 seal. Status: pending parts. No repair completion recorded.

records.title: Aster 17 operating guide
records.text: If V-2 leakage is observed, isolate and inspect the valve before returning to normal service. Escalate inconsistent pressure readings to the shift supervisor.

records.title: Technician observation
records.text: Technician noticed a faint hiss near V-2. Could not verify whether the seal leak worsened because access was restricted.

records.title: Birch 04 inspection
records.text: No visible leaks. Tubing pressure 165 bar and stable. Next routine inspection due in seven days.

records.title: Pump vibration follow-up
records.text: Bearing vibration rose to 8.2 mm/s. Lubrication completed, but repeat vibration check has not been logged.

records.title: Pump P03 maintenance guide
records.text: After bearing lubrication, record a repeat vibration measurement before closing the work order.
